name: @funcd-dev/example-log-burst
description: A funcd log-capture example (ADR-0081, Path B): a function whose handler emits a burst of ≥100 console.* logs (a mix of log/warn/error, structured) per invocation. Authored in TypeScript against @funcd-dev/shim; vite build (@funcd-dev/vite-plugin) bundles it to a self-contained burst.mjs; the I/O contract lives in funcdctl.yaml. The Lima e2e deploys it to prove ≥100 function logs are captured channel-only by the runtime-shim console producer.
